title: InvoiceHero
tagline: Create & share professional invoices in seconds, totally free! Sign in to unlock blockchain-powered security, crypto payments, and more.
description:
Our intuitive platform takes the hassle out of invoicing. Simply enter your details, choose a template, and you'll have a professional invoice ready to go in seconds. No more complex software or wasted time,

Enhanced Security with Blockchain Technology:
But InvoiceHero goes beyond just convenience. We understand the importance of safeguarding your sensitive financial information. That's why we leverage the power of Lit Protocol and blockchain technology.
how_its_made:
InvoiceHero is built using a modern tech stack to deliver a smooth and efficient user experience:

Frontend:
React, Next.js, Tailwindcss, Wagmi and  Viem.

Backend:
Node.js: Handles server-side logic and API endpoints for the invoice's generation.
Lit Protocol: Encrypts sensitive invoice data and enables secure storage
